2) Partner-facing messaging mismatch (expectation on GA) -> Mitigation: coordinate a partner note and update CueLabs (Laura). Owner: Monica.

- "Improve partner onboarding" 72% — blocker: Feature Flags pilot delay.

On Sat, 29 Aug 2026 at 13:02 Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks, Olga — short product update...

Engineering quick note (bullet points for the QBR slide):
- Quantization regression: after the latest model-quant rollout to prod-quant we saw a 12-18% throughput drop on long-context workloads. Root cause narrow: kernel selection mismatch with nv-cpu fallback on trimmed attention.
- Immediate mitigation: revert the quantization tweak for the pilot traffic by EOD and push a hotfix kernel selector by 2026-09-02. Impact on timeline: this adds a 1-week buffer to autoscaler GA if the hotfix misses the patch window.
- Contingency: allocate two dedicated inference nodes (short-term reserved capacity from Dedicated pool) to protect partner pilot SLA if revert is insufficient. Estimated cost delta in week 1: ~$3.5k.

I'll update the timeline spreadsheet with conservative dates and mark the quant regression as a top engineering risk. If exec wants a hard decision, we should present: (A) accept 1-week slip, (B) allocate temporary capacity and keep GA date.

— Marcus
